admission.justification: Realized across src/rh_pipeline/lean/parser.py and src/rh_pipeline/lean/_lexer.py and proved by unit tests and six synthetic fixtures covering all 305 src/New/ syntax forms and default-deny refusals, preventing silent misparsing or mid-signature splitting of upstream Lean files.

applicability: Closed-world top-level Lean 4 lexing, declaration and import extraction across src/rh_pipeline/lean/_lexer.py and src/rh_pipeline/lean/parser.py.
conditions: Normalizes CRLF/CR line endings and lexes via LeanLexer.tokenize() tracking nested block comments, strings, raw strings, char literals, guillemet names, => operators and four delimiter pairs ((), [], {}, ⦃⦄), scanning depth-0 := or where before line-initial equation-compiler | arms (preserving inline |x| norms), permitting unclosed sections to EOF and enforcing balanced namespace/end.

Strips chained scoped open/omit/seal/unseal/variable/include ... in prefixes from extracted signatures, overrides open namespaces on _root_. prefixes, synthesizes sequential namespace-qualified _instance_N names inserted into anonymous colon-typed instance signatures for round-trip parity, and raises UnsupportedLeanFormError(rel_path, line, form) on unlisted commands (macro, syntax, notation, mutual, set_option, universes, variables, standalone seal/unseal, example, #check), scoped or non-instance local modifiers, depth-0 termination_by/decreasing_by, colonless anonymous instances, unbalanced scopes, orphan prefixes/docs/attributes or unclosed lexical forms.
exclusions: Syntactic namespace qualification rewrites only the declared name span and does not rewrite internal signature tokens; opaque accepts either no body or an explicit := body.
statement: extract_declarations parses admitted top-level Lean 4 forms across src/rh_pipeline/lean/parser.py and src/rh_pipeline/lean/_lexer.py—including standalone open/variable/include/omit/export/universe/attribute/grind_pattern/local grind_pattern commands, chained scoped ... in prefixes, noncomputable sections, local/scoped attributes inside @[...], local instances, _root_. namespace overrides, depth-0 :=/where/equation-arm | body splitting, and namespace-qualified anonymous instances—while failing closed with UnsupportedLeanFormError(rel_path, line, form) on any unsupported construct.
title: Closed-world delimiter-aware Lean 4 declaration extractor
